featured_reviews.name: Dharmendar Passi
featured_reviews.review_text:
The company name is The Professional Courier; however, based on our experience, their services do not reflect the professionalism they claim—either in India or internationally.

On February 28, we handed over two parcels at their Vasco, Goa office for dispatch to clients in Canada and the USA. We paid INR 11,000, and a receipt was issued under the company’s name. The parcels were then forwarded to an agent in Mumbai, who was expected to ship them through an international courier partner.

However, the representative at the Vasco office failed to pay the Mumbai agent. As a result, the agent only generated tracking numbers without actually dispatching the parcels. These tracking details were shared with us, and in turn, we shared them with our clients.

Over the next two months, we repeatedly followed up, but the Vasco office representative continued to provide misleading information, often citing external issues such as “war” as the reason for delays. Meanwhile, our clients in the USA and Canada kept raising concerns.

We then escalated the matter to the Panaji head office. A customer service representative spoke with a senior representative , who instructed the Vasco branch to resolve the issue immediately. Unfortunately, no action was taken. We subsequently filed a police complaint. Although the police issued a warning (in person and over the phone), there was still no resolution.

In good faith, we even offered to continue working with them on the condition that the pending parcels be dispatched promptly. However, the representative stopped responding and did not answer calls.

Due to the urgency and our commitment to client satisfaction, we ultimately paid extra amount to the Mumbai agent directly to ensure the parcels were delivered.

Based on this experience, the communication was extremely poor, accountability was lacking, and support from the Goa head office was ineffective. It appears that such issues may not be isolated, and similar complaints may exist from other customers.

We strongly recommend exercising caution when dealing with The Professional Courier. Based on our experience, it is safer to work with reliable international courier companies rather than relying on services that claim professionalism but fail to deliver.

featured_reviews.name: Sachin Tomy
featured_reviews.review_text:
NilSi Express – My Honest Experience
I used NilSi Express to ship personal belongings from Kerala to Abu Dhabi—stuff like baby and household essentials, clothes, kitchen items, a child car seat, and even some homemade treats. I picked them mainly because they were much cheaper than other options.
Even though I had seen many negative reviews bashing them, I decided to go ahead, and after my experience, I trust that NilSi likely had valid reasons that weren’t mentioned in those reviews.
Pickup had a small hiccup at first—the initial team struggled—but the next team arrived quickly and collected everything. Mr. Simanchal was always available for my questions and kept me updated. They even sent videos of weigh-ins and shared updates during transit, which really eased my worries about the safety of my things.
Despite customs inspection, everything arrived in perfect condition. Boxes were fine, nothing damaged or broken. EMX, their delivery partner in Abu Dhabi, handled the final delivery smoothly.
Timeline: They promised 7–8 days, but it actually took longer (collected after Jan 10, delivered Feb 2). Waiting was stressful, especially since it was my first time sending cargo abroad—but their communication kept me sane.
Who should choose them: If you’re budget-conscious, NilSi Express is worth considering. Just know that timelines may stretch, so don’t rely on them for strict deadlines.

Pros:
#Very affordable compared to other options
#Responsive and helpful staff
#Transparent updates with weigh-in videos
#Safe handling of items.

Cons:
#Delivery took longer than expected
#Initial pickup partner had issues
#Not ideal if you have urgent or highly delicate shipments

Overall, for cost-conscious customers willing to be flexible with timelines, NilSi Express is a solid choice.
